scene_description: A classroom scene showing a female teacher standing at a green chalkboard with multiplication facts written on it. Several children are seated facing the teacher, and multiple students have their hands raised. The teacher's name 'Ms. Miller' is written on the board.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the chalkboard, desks, and the whole room around them.
